title: Grusch hospitalization and retained clearance
summary: Mick West tells of Grusch hospitalization and retained clearance, about 2010s at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: David Gush had like, you know, psychotic episode and was voluntarily hospitalized and he kept his clearance

plain: Mick West, a well-known UFO skeptic, said in a 2025 podcast debate that David Grusch, a former US intelligence officer who later told Congress about UFOs, had a psychotic episode sometime in the 2010s and checked himself into a hospital. West says Grusch kept his security clearance afterwards, meaning the government still let him see secret material. West raises it because, if true, it bears on how people weigh Grusch's later claims and how clearances are handled.
